title: PanoDiff-SR: Synthesizing Dental Panoramic Radiographs using Diffusion and Super-resolution
abstract: arXiv:2507.09227v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Interest in generating realistic synthetic medical images has grown in recent years. Such datasets can mitigate the scarcity of public data for artificial intelligence research and support education. Work on synthesizing dental panoramic radiographs (PRs) has so far relied almost exclusively on generative adversarial networks (GANs), and three limitations recur: the synthesized field of view is often restricted to a cropped dentoalveolar region rather than a complete PR; observer studies of GAN-generated PRs report that clinicians still identify synthetic images with accuracies of roughly 78-82%, implying persistent visible giveaways; and adversarial training remains sensitive to instability and mode collapse. Generating a full-size PR directly at diagnostic resolution with a diffusion model is an alternative, but sampling at that resolution is costly. We therefore present PanoDiff-SR, an end-to-end two-stage pipeline developed

translated_title: PanoDiff-SR：利用扩散模型与超分辨率技术合成牙科全景X光片
translated_abstract: 近年来，人们对生成逼真合成医学图像的兴趣日益增长。此类数据集可以缓解人工智能研究中公共数据稀缺的问题，并支持医学教育。迄今为止，合成牙科全景X光片（PR）的工作几乎完全依赖于生成对抗网络（GAN），且反复出现三个局限：合成的视野通常仅限于裁剪的牙槽区域，而非完整的全景X光片；针对GAN生成全景X光片的观察者研究表明，临床医生仍能以约78-82%的准确率识别出合成图像，这意味着合成图像始终存在可见的破绽；此外，对抗训练仍然对不稳定性和模式崩溃敏感。使用扩散模型直接以诊断分辨率生成全尺寸全景X光片是一种替代方案，但在该分辨率下采样成本高昂。因此，我们提出了PanoDiff-SR，一个端到端的两阶段流水线……
tldr: 本文提出PanoDiff-SR，一种结合扩散模型与超分辨率的端到端两阶段流水线，用于生成完整且达到诊断分辨率的全尺寸牙科全景X光片，克服了基于GAN方法存在的视野受限、易被临床医生识别以及训练不稳定等局限。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PanoDiff-SR, an end-to-end two-stage pipeline combining diffusion models and super-resolution to synthesize complete, full-size dental panoramic radiographs at diagnostic resolution, overcoming the limited field of view, detectability by clinicians, and training instability of GAN-based approaches.
